legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: "amalgamation" means the merger of an amalgamating co-operative bank with an amalgamated co-operative bank, if—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. For the purposes of section 64,— Section 65(a): "amalgamation" means the merger of an amalgamating co-operative bank with an amalgamated co-operative bank, if—

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: all the assets and liabilities of the amalgamating co-operative bank or banks immediately before the merger (other than the assets transferred, by sale or distribution on winding up, to the amalgamated co-operative bank) become the assets and liabilities of the amalgamated co-operative bank;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: the members holding 75% or more voting rights in the amalgamating co-operative bank become members of the amalgamated co-operative bank; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: the shareholders holding 75% or more in value of the shares in the amalgamating co-operative bank (other than the shares held by the amalgamated co-operative bank or its nominee or its subsidiary, immediately before the merger) become shareholders of the amalgamated co-operative bank;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: "amalgamating co-operative bank" means—

legal_units.text: a co-operative bank which merges with another co-operative bank; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. For the purposes of section 64,— Section 65(b): "amalgamating co-operative bank" means— Section 65(b)(i): a co-operative bank which merges with another co-operative bank; or

legal_units.text: every co-operative bank merging to form a new co-operative bank;

legal_units.text: "amalgamated co-operative bank" means—

legal_units.text: a co-operative bank with which one or more amalgamating co-operative banks merge; or

legal_units.text: a co-operative bank formed as a result of merger of two or more amalgamating co-operative banks;

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: "business reorganisation" means reorganisation of business involving the amalgamation or demerger of a co-operative bank or conversion of a primary co-operative bank;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. For the purposes of section 64,— Section 65(d): "business reorganisation" means reorganisation of business involving the amalgamation or demerger of a co-operative bank or conversion of a primary co-operative bank;

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: "conversion" means transition of a primary co-operative bank to a banking company under the scheme of the Reserve Bank of India as may be notified vide its circular number DCBR. CO. LS. PCB. Cir. No. 5/07.01.000/2018-19, dated 27th September, 2018;

legal_units.text: "converted banking company" means a banking company formed as a result of conversion from primary co-operative bank;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 65 Interpretation for purposes of section 64. For the purposes of section 64,— Section 65(f): "converted banking company" means a banking company formed as a result of conversion from primary co-operative bank;

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: "demerger" means the transfer by a demerged co-operative bank of one or more of its undertakings to any resulting co-operative bank, in such manner that—

legal_units.text: all the assets and liabilities of the undertaking or undertakings immediately before the transfer become the assets and liabilities of the resulting co-operative bank;

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: the assets and the liabilities are transferred to the resulting co-operative bank at values (other than change in the value of assets consequent to their revaluation) appearing in its books of account immediately before the transfer;

legal_units.text: the resulting co-operative bank issues, in consideration of the transfer, its membership to the members of the demerged co-operative bank on a proportionate basis;

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: the shareholders holding 75% or more in value of the shares in the demerged co-operative bank (other than shares already held by the resulting bank or its nominee or its subsidiary immediately before the transfer), become shareholders of the resulting co-operative bank, otherwise than as a result of the acquisition of the assets of the demerged co-operative bank or any undertaking thereof by the resulting co- operative bank;

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: the transfer of the undertaking is on a going concern basis; and

legal_units.title: Interpretation for purposes of section 64.
legal_units.text: the transfer is as per the conditions specified by the Central Government, by notification, having regard to the necessity to ensure that the transfer is for genuine business purposes;

legal_units.text: "predecessor co-operative bank" means the amalgamating co-operative bank or the demerged co-operative bank, or the primary co-operative bank, which has been succeeded as a result of conversion;
